$comment: Source is TypeScript now (src/host/*.ts, src/client/*.ts), and every .ts file is type-checked unconditionally — `checkJs` only governs plain .js files, of which src/ has none. noImplicitAny is TRUE: the 536 implicit-any sites the migration left behind are all annotated, so the rule is now enforced by the compiler instead of by a ratchet (scripts/audit-implicit-any.mjs still runs, with a budget of 0, as a second opinion and as the place the trajectory is recorded). strict stays false: strictNullChecks is the next decision, not an oversight, and turning it on now would be a different migration.
